strategos:template/unit_base.UnitMotion/walkSpeed: 3.75 blocks a second, a little under a walking player's 4.3, so a crowd reads as marching; M1's movement baselines are measured at it (D-11)
strategos:template/unit_base.UnitMotion/turnRate: Degrees a tick: a full turn in eight ticks, quick enough for orders to feel immediate, slow enough to see the turn
strategos:template/unit_base.Body/width: A player's hit box, so the vanilla humanoid model fits (D-04)
strategos:template/unit_base.Body/height: A player's hit box, so the vanilla humanoid model fits (D-04)
strategos:template/unit_base.Body/radius: The avoidance radius, a little over half the width, so a dense crowd still shows gaps between bodies (M1, PATH-06)

strategos:unit/debug_walker.UnitMotion/walkSpeed: Five blocks a second: the movement tests' brisk walker, never a game unit

strategos:unit/infantry.Attack/Melee/hack: With 100 hit points and resistance 5, one spearman kills another in 29 blows, about half a minute at a blow a second (M2, CMB-02)
strategos:unit/infantry.Attack/Melee/reach: A spear reaches a little past an arm's length
strategos:unit/infantry.Attack/Melee/prepare: Half a second's wind-up before the first thrust, so a charge reads
strategos:unit/infantry.Resistance/hack: 0.9^5 lets 59 % through: shield and padding make a fight between two spearmen last tens of seconds
strategos:unit/infantry.Resistance/crush: Padding does little against blunt blows; crush belongs to cavalry and siege later
